summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on cipher-box PR #296, including automated reviewer (GitHub Copilot) nitpicks and human reviewer comments across multiple review sessions.
summary.outcome: All unresolved review threads were triaged, 14+ fixes implemented across crypto/README.md, sdk/client.ts, TextEditorDialog.tsx, sdk-provider.ts, full-workflow.spec.ts, sharing-workflow.spec.ts, and multi-account-wallet.ts, with all threads replied to and resolved.

repo: cipher-box is a monorepo with packages: @cipherbox/crypto, @cipherbox/sdk, apps/web, and tests/e2e using pnpm workspaces
FolderTree.clear() zeros all stored folder keys — meaning registerFolder storing caller-owned buffers directly is a security concern since destroy() will zero those caller buffers
SDK uses a notifySafely() pattern for lifecycle hooks to prevent throwing hooks from breaking operations
clearBytes() from @cipherbox/crypto is used for zeroing sensitive key material (already imported in client.ts)
UI-level serialization handles concurrent folder mutations, making SDK-level locking not required for this extraction PR
ipns.service.ts stale comment referencing @cipherbox/crypto was already fixed in a prior commit before the session began

code.finding: Background re-wrap shares folderKey buffer with caller — defensive copy + clearBytes in .finally() required
fileKey not cleared if exception occurs before the re-wrap try/catch — needs try/finally wrapping entire post-upload path
Lifecycle hook callbacks can throw and break operations — requires notifySafely() wrapper
createFolder leaks folderKey/ipnsPrivateKey on exception — duplicate-name check should be moved before key generation, with try/finally cleanup
registerFolder stores caller-owned key buffers directly; getFolderIpnsPrivateKey should return a copy to avoid caller mutating internal state
ensureFolderRegistered accepted unloaded placeholder folders with empty keys — needs guard on isLoaded and non-zero key lengths
Passing Uint8Array directly to Blob requires 'as BlobPart' type assertion due to TypeScript's strict Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> vs BlobPart incompatibility
requestAnimationFrame handle (focusRaf) was inside async IIFE — must be hoisted to effect scope to enable cancelAnimationFrame in cleanup
180s timeout too tight for 3 sequential wallet logins — increased to 300s
240s timeout insufficient — cumulative waits (auth restore + vault + root sync + file) total ~330s worst case, increased to 360s
120s timeout insufficient — two navigateIntoFolder retries plus two 60s content waits exceeded budget, increased to 240s

Context leak on failure during account creation — both createWalletTestAccount and createWalletTestAccounts need cleanup on partial failure; context.close() errors in cleanup should be swallowed to avoid masking root cause

workflow: gh api graphql reviewThreads query with isResolved filter is the reliable way to find unresolved PR threads; REST API misses some thread types
Reply to threads via REST with --field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID (integer) and --raw-field body; resolve via GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread
Outside-diff-range review comments appear in the review body, not as threads — requires fetching the full review body separately
pnpm typecheck across all packages before committing catches cross-package type incompatibilities early
Background test tasks with TaskOutput can be checked after the fact; no need to block on them if SDK-specific tests can be run directly

friction: Tests were run multiple times as background tasks and had to be checked via TaskOutput — added latency and required extra polling
A stale lock file had to be removed before committing (implied by 'Remove stale lock and commit' step)
Outside-diff-range comments are not surfaced by the standard reviewThreads GraphQL query — required separately fetching full review body by review ID
TypeScript strict Uint8Array typing caused an unexpected typecheck failure after the TextEditorDialog.tsx Blob fix, requiring a second edit with 'as BlobPart'
open_items: Concurrent mutations to same folder (sdk/client.ts:360) — architectural improvement deferred; current UI-level serialization is sufficient for this PR but not a permanent solution
Full E2E test suite not run after fixes — only unit tests were verified; E2E tests with the new timeout values were not locally validated
